C0791.title: Alert: Leaking Chipmakers' Core Supply Chain Data Abroad Constitutes a Crime Even for Minimal Profit
C0791.summary: A typical case released by the Supreme Peoples Procuratorate in April 2026 shows that Tian, a senior procurement manager at a Shanghai semiconductor company, was entrusted by an overseas institution and provided business information such as wafer procurement categories, suppliers, and procurement ratios through online conference calls, illegally earning more than 3,600 yuan. In February 2025, Shanghai No. 3 Intermediate Peoples Court convicted Tian of illegally providing trade secrets abroad and imposed imprisonment and a fine. The case shows that leaking core chip supply-chain business data abroad may also constitute a crime.
